notes: Components you add now just play on the video: no outlines or bands, and slim blocks on the timeline.
Fixed: some videos tinted components with a cream background.
Picking a caption style explains how captions get built.
If Cutnote restarts (after an update, or when you restart it), open pages now reload by themselves at the same moment, so the video never freezes.
Sidebar tabs: Notes, Library and Captions.
Library: animated components in collections. Drag one onto the video and it plays there right away, with a neon block on the timeline you can drag to retime.
